## Publication boundary

- [ ] Current user explicitly authorized these public-repository writes/commit/push.
- [ ] No private paths, settings, saves, logs, manifests, secrets, backups or unapproved upstream files included.
- [ ] Any private/public contradiction was reconciled against private authority before publication.
- [ ] No status promoted without exact evidence.
- [ ] No release/tag/archive/asset/binary action without separate specific release authorization.
- [ ] Relevant redistribution/credits uncertainty remains explicit.

Do not put private evidence or conversation contents into a public PR description. Link only intentionally public sources. Documentation authorization does not authorize a release.
